raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 delivered txn_ts in day-first DD/MM/YYYY form (for example '17/01/2026 06:02:01'), while the other batches use ISO format, and the unconditional CAST to TIMESTAMP fails on those rows. The min of the DD/MM strings starts at '17/', so every such value has a day above 12 and the day-first reading is unambiguous.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
